form.title: Destination address
form.hint: Type the address as the customer wrote it: Calle 146 # 21-86, Apto 302. We look it up in Bogota's cadastral address register.
form.label: Address

result.label: Estimated delivery cost
result.margin: Give or take {amount}, measured by leaving each past delivery out of the fit in turn.
result.marginUnknown: Not enough recorded courier charges yet to measure how far off this can be.
result.minFare: Below the minimum fare, so the estimate is the {amount} floor.
result.empty: Enter an address to see an estimate.
result.noEstimate: No estimate. The address could not be located and the street grid did not apply either.

exact.note: The cadastre holds this exact address. The coordinates are the building's own.

nearestNumber.note: The street and cross-street are right, but this exact house number is not registered. The closest number on the same block was used — usually a few metres out.

nearestCross.note: This exact address does not exist in the cadastre. We used a neighbouring address on the same street, at a different cross-street. Check the matched address below before you quote this price.

streetSegment.note: We found the street but not the address on it, so this is the middle of the whole street. On a long street that can be kilometres away from the real destination.

gridFallback.note: The address was not found at all. This number comes from the old approximate grid, which assumes every block is 100 m — it is not a real location.

failed.note: The address could not be located at all.

warning.low: Do not quote this price as-is.
warning.medium: Check the matched address before quoting.

truncated.heading: The address lookup ran out of time.
truncated.body: This result is provisional and does not mean the address is missing. Retry — the parts that finished are cached, so it will be fast.

error.generic: The estimate could not be calculated. Please try again.

feedback.question: Once the courier quotes you — what did they actually charge?
feedback.explainer: Every real price you record here is shared with the whole team and makes the next estimate better.
feedback.saved: Saved. The model has been re-fitted with this price.
feedback.error: That price could not be saved. Please try again.

calibration.removeConfirm: Remove this recorded courier charge from the model?
calibration.loadError: The recorded charges could not be loaded.

footer.implicitConsent: By placing an order, you agree to our personal data processing policy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Personal Data Processing

dataController.title: 1. Data Controller
dataController.content: The data controller is [COMPANY NAME], identified with NIT [NIT], located at [ADDRESS], Colombia. Email: [EMAIL]. Phone: [PHONE].

purpose.title: 2. Purpose of Data Processing
purpose.content: Your personal data will be processed for:
items: Communicating with you about your order status

rights.title: 4. Data Subject Rights
rights.content: Under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012, you have the right to:
items: Know, update, and rectify your data
Be informed about the use of your data
Revoke authorization and request deletion of your data
File complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce

retention.title: 5. Data Retention
retention.content: Your data will be kept while you maintain a relationship with us and for the time necessary to comply with legal and contractual obligations.

security.title: 6. Security Measures
security.content: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

exerciseRights.title: 7. How to Exercise Your Rights
exerciseRights.content: To exercise your rights, you can:
items: Request data deletion on our website

complaints.title: 8. Data Protection Authority
complaints.content: If you believe your rights have been violated, you can file a complaint with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC).

delete.title: Data Deletion Request
delete.description: Enter your phone number to request the deletion of your personal data from our system.
delete.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Colombian phone number
delete.confirmLabel: I confirm that I want to permanently delete my data and understand this includes my order history.
delete.successMessage: Your data has been deleted from our system.
delete.errorNotFound: We could not find an account associated with this phone number.
delete.warning: Warning: This action is permanent and will delete all your data, including order history.
